candidate.title: API route default-imports zod, making `z` undefined and crashing on module load
reports: [bug] the route default-imports zod (import z from "zod"), but zod's commonjs entry sets esmodule and exports no default, so z binds to undefined at runtime. z.object(...) on line 9 throws typeerror: cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'object') when the route module first loads, so every request to post /api/webhook/app-credential returns a 500 — the inbound credential-sync webhook never functions at all (every other file in this repo uses import { z } from "zod").
candidate.example: [bug] the route default-imports zod (import z from "zod"), but zod's commonjs entry sets esmodule and exports no default, so z binds to undefined at runtime. z.object(...) on line 9 throws typeerror:

fix_scope: minimal fix for the demonstrated instance only

sibling_instances.note: other instances of this class are unverified siblings; fix.patch does not address them

claim_restated: The API route must not crash during module initialization when zod has no default export, so it should import z as a named export.
expected_failure: API route should not crash on module load when zod has no default export (must import { z })
